sentences.span: The tape is Brent at $95... US 10-year 4.80%... if we want relief on rates we first need relief on energy.
sentences.why: Brent $95 and 10-year 4.80% both stated, and the 'order of operations' framing is the desk's own quoted logic.

sentences.span: Goldman's Industrials specialist, Amanda Ross, summarized the chaos... She reiterated: The desk trade is still inverse heating oil versus the 10-year.
sentences.why: Source frames this as 'the desk trade' that Ross reiterated/relayed as an Industrials specialist, not a position she personally runs. The sentence changes attribution from 'desk trade she restated' to 'her own position.'

sentences.span: Germany's 10yr real yield (+1.7bps) at a post-2011 high of 0.99%, suggesting this wasn't just a story of high inflation expectations.
sentences.why: Figure, country, and 'not just inflation expectations' framing match exactly.

sentences.span: the decline was most obvious at the front-end, which showed how it was the Fed commentary driving the moves... the rally was more marginal further out, with the 10yr yield (-1.1bps...) actually closing a touch above their levels just before Waller's comments.
sentences.why: Source distinguishes the session's move as Fed-commentary-driven at the front end, with the long end barely moving despite the energy pullback -- supporting a pattern break not explained by energy falling.

sentences.span: Privo concludes by saying he would remain cautious on duration now that month-end support has passed... yields can continue higher.
sentences.why: The bond-caution/month-end claim is directly supported, but no source states energy is 'nearer the high end of its near-term range' -- the same note instead calls Brent/WTI 'somewhat range-bound.' An unsupported claim is grafted onto a real one.

sentences.span: George Cole's overlay... The sell-off is fundamental, not fragile. 'The tell for us is what isn't happening: rates vol hasn't broken higher.' Forecasts still have 10 year yields down 30-40bp if the driver goes away.
sentences.why: Matches attribution, the fundamental-not-fragile framing, the vol test, and the 30-40bp forecast conditional on the energy driver reversing.

sentences.span: the prices paid component moved up to a 4-year high of 72.6... which is notable given that this series is strongly correlated to inflation with a 3-month lag.
sentences.why: Figure and the inflation-correlation lag claim match exactly.

sentences.why: All figures, GW counts, and the Anthropic-largest-FY27-customer claim match.

sentences.span: the equity volatility collapse/capitulation has gone 'epic'... options market makers and dealers are choking on huge PNL losses... Spot Equities market only bleeds lower on low realized
sentences.why: Fair paraphrase of the note's core thesis that the vol/options complex, not spot equities, is where the damage is concentrated.

sentences.span: IWM 3m ATM iVol which has collapsed to the 0.2% percentile... SPX Skew and Put Skew back to 2%ile... Dispersion profitability over the past month has cratered down to just the 5%-ile
sentences.why: All three percentile figures match; 'trades that bet stocks move apart' is a fair plain-English gloss for dispersion trades.

sentences.why: Direct match, including the source's own 'pricing power' framing.

sentences.why: All four figures and the 'permanent break, not a pause' framing match.
